stories.title: Two newly detained men testify in the case over the shooting of the Bolivian lawyer
stories.summary: Two men held as part of the investigation into the shooting of Bolivian lawyer Nadia Beller gave statements to prosecutors in Santa Cruz de la Sierra on Sunday. One is accused of supplying the weapon used in the ambush; the other, a Colombian national identified as a possible gunman, turned himself in after learning he was being sought.

stories.title: Gabon revives Its cultural heritage at Libreville’s festival of cultures
stories.summary: After an eight-year absence, Libreville has once again become a showcase for Gabon’s rich cultural diversity, as the 15th edition of the Festival of Cultures brings together traditions, languages, rituals and craftsmanship from across the country. Held from August 21 to 23 along Avenue Jean-Paul II, the festival brings together representatives of Gabon’s nine provinces, alongside artists, artisans, cultural groups and visitors. This year’s theme is “Reappropriation of our Cultural Values.” For young visitors, many of whom were born after the festival’s previous edition, the event is less a return to a familiar tradition than an opportunity to discover their heritage. “It’s our heritage. Nowadays, it’s very old and very rare, because even at the National Museum, you can no longer find many of these objects,” one young visitor said. He said preserving traditional objects and practices was important at a time when some were misunderstood. “It has nothing to do with witchcraft. It’s about preserving our history, so that we have a record of it.” Another young visitor described the festival as an opportunity to reconnect with Gabonese history and culture. “We can rediscover our culture, our history and our heritage through this festival. It’s truly a wealth of knowledge being offered to us.”
